volumeInfo.title: GMAT Prep Plus 2027–2028
volumeInfo.description: This title is fully updated for the new GMAT (which debuted in late 2023). It covers all three sections of the current GMAT: Quantitative Reasoning, including all math content and strategies for the Problem Solving question type that appears in this section Data Insights, including all data content and strategies for the five question types that appear in this section (Data Sufficiency, Tables, Graphs, Two-Parts, and Multi-Source Reasoning) Verbal Reasoning, including all strategies for the two question types that appear in this section (Critical Reasoning and Reading Comprehension) This comprehensive title was written by expert Kaplan GMAT instructors who have taken the official GMAT themselves and taught thousands of students how to study effectively and efficiently to earn their own great scores. The practice problems were created by real Kaplan GMAT experts to ensure that they mimic real GMAT problems as closely as possible, and every problem was solved and every solution was reviewed by at least one additional Kaplan GMAT expert to make sure everything is the highest possible quality for your studies. In addition, this title will help you study efficiently. The most frequently-tested content areas are emphasized more heavily, so that your study time is weighted towards the areas that are most likely to pay off on test day. Most of the Data Insights question types are interactive, such as sorting tables, navigating among tabs, and choosing from drop-down menus. These question types can only properly be delivered in a digital format, so this book also includes an online Qbank with hundreds of additional practice problems. Design your own quizzes using parameters that you choose (including question type, content area, difficulty level, and number of problems) and solve problems in a digital format that mimics how you’ll solve on test day.
